selected_by_owner: 2026-10-05 owner approved the CWKS-09 written design and implementation plan, approved the four recommended V1 defaults, and directed Continue.

dependencies.parallel_lane_rule: GPR PCV-03F and FGA-06 remain independently in_progress. CWKS-09 may not borrow their scope or branches; final publication uses READY/FIFO while multiple persistent lanes remain nonterminal.

scope.name: Comments, Review, Version History, Comparison and Recovery
in_scope: immutable native CreatorDocumentV1 history snapshots with stable version identity and deterministic fingerprints
five-minute bounded automatic history capture only after successful durable saves plus named/session/review/restore checkpoints
document-level and text-range comments with deterministic exact/reanchored/orphaned anchor behavior
detached human review proposals with stale-base protection and explicit accept/reject
deterministic canonical-document comparison with stable node identity and accessible diff projections
non-destructive native historical restore through CWKS-05 compare-and-swap saves
read-only D29 legacy-history presentation and explicit deterministic legacy-to-native recovery preview
reusable accessible Review & History UI across generic editor, Story Project, Wiki, and Creator Suite
provider-off Linux/Windows deterministic validation and sealed CWKS/D29 regressions
out_of_scope: CreatorDocumentV1 schema mutation for review metadata
collaborative live editing, presence, cursors, CRDT or OT behavior
AI critique, rewriting, summarization or generation
automatic history pruning or compaction in V1

defaults.history_retention: no automatic pruning in CWKS-09 V1
defaults.desktop_diff: unified diff for V1 across viewport sizes
defaults.removed_comment_presentation: durable removed state rendered as Comment removed

next_action: CWKS-09 is completed_verified. Retire CWKS-09 validation-family and hosted-Windows authority on Multiversal-app; do not activate CWKS-10 without separate owner selection.
